name: Growing robot
full_name: Hybrid tendon-notched continuum robot + hydraulic everting (growing) robot
versions: single (T-MRB 2025); 2021: VINE everting (growing) catheter, UCSB/UCSD/Stanford, same team (Li 2021 T-MRB) (Alekseeva 2025 Table 12 row 9, Fig. 19g) (alekseeva2025_design)
target_anatomy: neuro: type III aortic arch and extremely tortuous ICA benchtop models (mechanical thrombectomy)
devices_driven: own growing robot (2.67 mm OD, about 8 Fr) that pulls a commercial 5 Fr aspiration catheter (SOFIA); notched base 7.6 mm OD
n_dof_detail: notched base two segments, tendon-driven by 2 capstans; growth by fluid pressure; system roll and insertion
translation_detail: other: eversion by hydraulic pressure (35-40 kPa) plus linear actuator and friction drive for the aspiration catheter
device_range: growing robot length 445 mm (S8 citing mangan Sec. III-C)
force_sensing: pressure sensor on growth fluid; N.R. for tip force
validation_detail: silicone arch and ICA models with two 360-degree loops of 7.3 mm radius; one full deployment in under 10 min with mock clot (Sec. VI-D, S8); no repeated-trial success rate found
key_numbers: growth pressure 35-40 kPa; housing withstands 85 kPa; steering error 9.9 +/- 1.2 % and 17.6 +/- 0.7 % of segment length (S8 citing Sec. VI-A); retraction buckles
sim_model: none found in text scanned (kinematics of notched robot and design optimisation reported; no simulator)
